about_short_description.short_description: Gong is a technology company that offers a revenue intelligence platform using AI to analyze customer interactions.

product.name: Gong Revenue AI Platform
product.description: A unified platform that centralizes revenue workflows, providing AI-driven insights and process automation to support sales and revenue teams.

product.name: Gong Engage
product.description: A tool that prioritizes and personalizes customer engagements to help sales teams create and convert pipeline opportunities.

product.name: Gong Forecast
product.description: A forecasting solution that uses extensive customer data and analytics to improve forecast accuracy and support organizational decision-making.

product.name: Gong Agents
product.description: A collection of AI-powered agents designed to automate and enhance revenue-related workflows within existing business ecosystems.

product.name: Gong Data Engine
product.description: A data management solution that automates data capture, mapping, and protection to provide comprehensive customer visibility across the revenue lifecycle.

product.name: Gong Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant within Gong that helps revenue teams automate tasks and surface insights from customer interactions.
